nodes.label: Q1: Wiki rule: 109 docs, 19 unreachable
nodes.explain: How should the repository get back under the wiki rule: 109 Markdown files against a cap of 100 (this package adds 4 more), and 19 reader documents not reachable from wiki/index.md within two links (for example evaluation/terminal_state/README.md)? Settled by: Argument, no test: either archive superseded handoffs and evaluation notes into docs/archive/ (the rule counts them too) and link the live ones from wiki/index.md, or add .md-file-cap.yaml with a limit and a reason the evaluation records must stay as files. Pick by reading which of the 19 are still read; the check's own output names them.

nodes.label: Q10: Reconcile the seed and review 858 records?
nodes.explain: Should the curated founding seed be reconciled against the full ChatGPT export and its 858 proposed annotations reviewed by a person (issue #3)? Default: The seed stays all proposed and labelled not source-complete; issue #3 stays open.
